description: Wide aerial over vast harvested/stubble fields with a road, sun low in the sky at upper-centre, warm golden haze; very slow drift. Usable whole clip (0-15s). Flat, dry plains read as North-Indian wheat belt. Also works for shot 4 and as finale alternate.
author: Coverr

description: Drone flies low and forward over a freshly planted/young crop field toward a low, hazy golden sun; strong backlit flare, long tree shadows, warm late-afternoon light. Best 0-20s (pure fields + tree line). From ~22s plastic greenhouses enter frame and dominate after ~27s - avoid. Centre-crop friendly (sun near centre).
author: @marcolopez (Mixkit)

description: Low-angle through dry golden grass toward a setting sun behind trees, lens flares, grass blowing; slow push/sway. Best 0-12s (sun visible, warmest). Very cinematic golden-hour texture.
author: @matthiasgroeneveld (Mixkit)

description: Close-up of dry, rust-gold seed heads/grass stems moving in wind, shallow depth of field, blurred blue-green background; 60fps (slow-mo capable). Best 0-13s.
author: Coverr

description: Close-up of tall pale-golden dry reeds/grass stalks swaying in wind against a bright overexposed sky; soft natural light; handheld-steady. Strong texture shot for crop residue/straw. Best 0-16s, whole clip usable.
author: @rubenvelasco (Mixkit)

description: Medium shot of a farm worker (face fully covered by a cloth/balaclava, grey shirt) bending and cutting golden ripe paddy by hand with a sickle; other harvesters in background, palm trees on horizon, bright overcast daylight. Reads South/South-East Asian. Hands gripping stalks visible 3-10s. Not true golden hour.
author: Coverr

description: Backlit hand raised against the sun letting soil/dirt fall through fingers, big lens flare, trees in background; warm. Best 2.4-6s (hand in silhouette with sun) and 9.7-13s (falling particles). Earth not straw - closest substitute for the "farmer hand" beat.
author: Coverr

description: Wide low-angle across a ripe golden paddy field with a worker bending to harvest in mid-ground and several others behind, palms on horizon, cumulus sky; static/slight drift. Best 0-11s. Strong South-Asian rural feel.
author: Coverr

description: Wide shot: small group of harvesters working in a golden/green paddy field beside a single large tree, blue sky with clouds, slow lateral drift. Best 0-10s. Daylight, not golden hour.
author: Coverr

description: Low aerial forward over a huge harvested field with parallel stubble/tillage rows converging to the horizon, hazy blue sky, soft daylight. Best 0-10s. Rows give strong leading lines in a 9:16 crop.
author: Coverr

description: Top-down drone over a ripe wheat field: starts on dense golden crop (0-4s) then drifts over a harvested area with tractor/harvester track lines and scattered straw tufts (6-24s). Flat abstract texture; good bed for titles.
author: @vreel (Mixkit)

description: Close-up inside a wood factory: blue-green machine housing heaped with fine wood shavings/sawdust, flexible extraction duct in foreground, shallow focus; static. Small yellow hazard sticker visible (no brand). Best 0-14s.
author: Coverr

description: PHOTO (1051x972, low-res, 2003). Two cupped hands holding a small pile of pale wood pellets over a concrete floor; flat daylight. Usable only small/with Ken Burns at limited scale - not hero quality.
author: Tom Bruton (Wikimedia Commons)

description: NATIVE VERTICAL 1080x1920. Close-up of a woodworking machine table piled with fresh pale wood shavings, plank passing, shavings/sawdust flying and falling; worker in blue partially visible top-right after ~5s. Best 0-5s (no person). Closest available to raw biomass feedstock in motion.
author: @edgarfernandez (Mixkit)

description: Daylight medium-wide of an industrial plant: two tall white chimneys and steel process towers/columns, light steam, blue sky with clouds; static. Best 0-10s. Cooler daylight - needs warm grade.
author: @dubassy (Mixkit)

description: Silhouetted industrial plant/refinery skyline with tall chimneys and billowing white smoke/steam drifting across a warm hazy sky; locked-off, 25fps, ~30s. Excellent "power-plant buyer" establishing shot, warm tone. Whole clip usable.
author: @dubassy (Mixkit)

description: Top-down close-up of a roaring fire of wood blocks/charcoal with bright flames and glowing embers; handheld slight movement. Reads as a furnace/boiler burn of briquettes. Best 0-11s.
author: Coverr

description: Factory interior close-up: powered feed rollers and wheels pushing a wooden board through a processing line, shallow depth of field, cool industrial light; static. Whole clip (0-24s) is the same action. Also works for shot 8.
author: Coverr

description: Industrial lathe turning a long steel cylinder with the tool post/carriage in foreground; metal chips; slow lateral move. Clean modern workshop, cool light. Whole clip usable (0-13s).
author: @edgarfernandez (Mixkit)

description: Macro of a metal lathe: spinning chuck and cutting tool carving steel, curls of swarf and a puff of smoke/coolant at 2.7-5s and 8-10s; warm beige background, shallow focus. Best 2.5-10s.
author: @edgarfernandez (Mixkit)

description: Close-up of a laminated timber beam on a steel conveyor/guide sliding into a factory machine; safety warning stickers visible on machine 8-16s (generic pictograms, no brand). Best 0-8s.
author: Coverr

description: Low-key close-up profile of a young East-Asian man in glasses and suit on a phone call, dark background; at 16-19s a monitor with stock-style charts appears behind. Moody, premium; not South Asian. Best 3-12s.
author: Coverr

description: Brown-skinned hands working a laptop trackpad showing a spreadsheet/analytics dashboard with line charts, office window with city bokeh, papers on desk; slow push. Faces not visible. Laptop is a MacBook (small "MacBook Pro" text and macOS dock visible) - crop or blur if brand-neutral needed. Best 0-10s.
author: @marcolopez (Mixkit)

description: Worker/site manager in yellow hard hat and hi-vis vest talking on a phone while walking past brick pillars and scaffolding; daylight. Person is Caucasian (not South Asian) - use only as fallback for the industrial-site phone beat. Best 2-8s.
author: @joshjanssen (Mixkit)

description: Aerial tracking over a two-lane highway through dry harvested fields at golden hour; articulated trucks travel along the road, long shadows. A white trailer with a red company logo is legible 0-3s - start at ~4s where trucks are small. Best 4-14s. Also a great shot-4/shot-1 alternate.
author: Coverr

description: Forklift moving a large stacked load of processed timber boards across a warehouse floor; static camera, neutral indoor light. Best 0-11s.
author: Coverr

description: Static wide: red semi-truck with a bulk tipper trailer drives right-to-left across frame on an open plain road with mountains, blue sky. Truck in frame 0-6s, crosses centre ~4-5s (good for centre crop). No visible branding at this distance.
author: @edgarfernandez (Mixkit)

description: Slow move past tall stacked pallets of timber/wood in a bright warehouse with skylights; neutral light. Best 0-11s. Good "inventory/supply" beat.
author: Coverr

description: High aerial pushing over low clouds and a lake valley toward distant mountains under a soft dusk sky; cool-blue with warm horizon. Epic scale for finale. Whole clip 0-15s.
author: @marcolopez (Mixkit)

description: Rising/forward aerial along a straight road through scrubland toward the setting sun, mountains on horizon, warm flare; symmetrical composition perfect for 9:16 centre crop. Best 0-12s (road + sun balanced), later frames brighter.
author: @rubenvelasco (Mixkit)

description: Slow aerial/rising move over dry grassland hills at golden hour, warm red-brown tones, 60fps; native 1920x1012 (slightly letterboxed ratio). Best 0-8s.
author: Coverr

description: Close-up of a fire at night with bursts of sparks and embers flying up (strong bursts ~1.5-3.5s and 15-17s); dark background, warm red-orange. Great transition/texture.
author: Coverr

description: Out-of-focus orange ember particles drifting on pure black - overlay/texture plate (screen blend). Whole clip 0-14s.
author: @edgarfernandez (Mixkit)
